waivers.verdict: Mendoza went to sparkJ88 for $47, more than the card would have bid, so missing the deadline cost nothing. Swap Will Reichard for Cam Little at kicker if Sleeper lets you add him now. Lineup moves are in today's lineup report.

lineup.verdict: Three swaps, unchanged from Wednesday and still live in the app: Jaylen Warren in for Bucky Irving (bye), Bryce Young in for Jared Goff at QB (your rule — Goff's matchup is still ordinary, not exceptional), Mike Gesicki in for Malik Washington at FLEX (Miami's still down to Kyle McCord). Cousins holds SUPER_FLEX, Kraft holds TE, Houston holds DEF, Reichard holds K pending the Cam Little waiver swap.

trades.verdict: Hold. Full re-scan of all 12 rosters finds nothing that clears the bar — no trade projects better in every window once the other side's own needs are weighed in.

inactives.verdict: Nobody new is Out or Doubtful. But Goff's early Munich kickoff already passed, which locks Thursday's planned QB swap out of the QB slot for good — it has to land at SUPER_FLEX instead, starting Young over Cousins. Irving (bye) for Warren at RB and Gesicki for Washington at FLEX are unchanged from Thursday and still open — make all three before the 1pm kickoffs.
